page_title: EIN 1-2 STU | Eintracht Frankfurt v Stuttgart 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+2' Substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Enzo Millot walks off.
90+2' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:5.

88' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
87' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Patrick Schwengers blows for a foul.
85' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
83' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Substitution. Buta walks off the pitch and Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
80' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Omar Marmoush.
80' That's the end of the game for Deniz Undav, who is replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
79' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

78' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Ansgar Knauff.
69' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a rebound, makes a bit of ground then unleashes a shot from distance that swerves at the last second and goes a whisker wide of the left post.
67' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
66' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for holding. Patrick Schwengers signals a set piece.
64' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
60' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart).
60' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jamie Leweling and he is replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
55' A substitution has been made. Philipp Max goes off and Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
54' CHANCE! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
52' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
50' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
46' It looks like the ref can’t continue. He’s going to be replaced by Patrick Schwengers.
45+5' Felix Brych has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 1 - 2 Referee Felix Brych points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) goes wild in celebration.
45+2' The Stuttgart players joy may have been justified, because referee Felix Brych is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
45+1' Stuttgart have a goal ruled out for offside!
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

42' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
39' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
38' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
36' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes to nothing.
32' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
30' A snap shot by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
29' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.

26' 1 - 1 Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it under the crossbar of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
24' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
20' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
17' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
13' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
11' Stuttgart are awarded a free kick from long range.
8' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
6' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

1' 0 - 1 Goal! Enzo Millot displays great vision and sends a pass to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Felix Brych was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
